evals.prompt: Summarize this architectural review for the team. It has six risks, two decisions, and a phased migration plan.
expectations: Offers or creates one self-contained HTML report rather than a long chat response.
Uses the shared Ruby-dark tokens from a single :root block.
Includes an evidence-oriented report layout and a render verification step.

evals.prompt: Create an HTML comparison of the three hosting options and save it in /private/tmp/decision-artifacts.
expectations: Writes one offline-capable HTML file in the user-specified directory.
Uses a responsive semantic comparison table and names the stated assumptions.
Does not use external fonts, images, scripts, stylesheets, or network requests.
